featured.title: Autonomous Job Application Agent
featured.description: A Python agent harness integrating Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini that has run unattended on a cloud Linux VPS for over a year. Multi-stage LLM decision logic with tool selection and chaining, fallback strategies, hard-rejection guardrails, and retry logic. RAG-style retrieval injects structured context into prompts; outputs are validated as structured JSON against multi-criteria checks, with severity-routed alerting and end-of-run metrics.

featured.title: Shayaak — Wellness Web App
featured.description: A full-stack wellness app: daily journal, task manager, weight tracking, and Saya — an AI companion powered by a self-hosted Llama 3.2 model running on the same box via Ollama. Multi-user with session auth, React front end, Express + SQLite back end. I run the whole stack myself on a Hetzner VPS: nginx, SSL, systemd services, git-based deploys, and nightly database backups.

featured.title: Lumen — Automated Data-Analysis Dashboard
featured.description: Upload any dataset and get a dashboard: KPIs, plain-English insights, auto-generated charts, and dataset-agnostic anomaly detection with scikit-learn Isolation Forest. Includes a SQL query sandbox, a leak-free AutoML pipeline (Pipeline + ColumnTransformer, cross-validated), and one-click HTML reporting. Pure-function analysis engine with full pytest coverage; cleaning workflows export as runnable pandas code.

portfolio.title: Multi-Channel YouTube Content Agent
portfolio.description: Config-driven Python framework producing tonally distinct video content across 4 production channels — research, script, voice-over, and render orchestrated across 5+ external services, published on a staggered cron schedule. Private repo; running in production.

portfolio.title: Supply Chain Analytics Platform
portfolio.description: Real-time ETL processing 5,000+ transactions with Pydantic validation and retry logic. Ensemble anomaly detection (Z-score, IQR, Isolation Forest, Elliptic Envelope) with severity-routed Slack/Email alerting, Holt-Winters/ARIMA forecasting validated against holdouts, and a 6-page Plotly Dash dashboard.

portfolio.title: TaskForge — Distributed Task Orchestration
portfolio.description: Cloud-native task orchestration platform: gRPC microservices, Kafka event streaming, event sourcing with CQRS and saga patterns, Kubernetes deployment with HPA autoscaling, and OpenTelemetry + Prometheus observability.

portfolio.title: Resume Tailor
portfolio.description: Local-first resume and cover letter generator: paste a job description and a locally hosted LLM (Ollama) tailors ATS-friendly PDFs. No cloud APIs — everything runs on my own machine.

portfolio.title: Mars Rover — University Rover Challenge
portfolio.description: Led the CS team through the full lifecycle: requirements, design, embedded C++ for sensor subsystems over UART/SPI/I2C, and hardware/software debugging with logic analyzers and gdb. MATLAB/Simulink models validated that physical hardware matched simulated response.

portfolio.title: Smart Home Network
portfolio.description: IoT home automation on Arduino/ESP8266 — lighting, sensors, and appliances controlled through a web interface.

portfolio.title: Battleship (C++)
portfolio.description: Classic Battleship built in modern C++ with an object-oriented design and CSV-based game persistence.

portfolio.title: Web Page Rank
portfolio.description: PageRank implemented and optimized over the Stanford web graph (~280K nodes) using NetworkX and sparse matrix operations, with visualizations of community structure and node importance.
